Games/MagicatWarriors
Warriors 126Magic 119

Curry's 41 wins it in overtime

Final · OT · Sat, Nov 7 · Golden State

Golden State beat Orlando 126–119 in overtime, a 7-point home win. The Warriors move to 7–3; the Magic fall to 2–7.

▶ Jump to the play

1 · What happened

The game, in 5 parts.

THE STORY · SCROLL
1 of 5 · First half

How it started.

The Warriors led 31–19 after one quarter. At the half, the Warriors led 57–41.

2 of 5 · The difference

Curry: 41 points, 10 of 10 at the line

19 in the fourth quarter and overtime, on 13-of-19 shooting.

3 of 5 · How it turned

Won the first quarter 31–19

From the opening tip, the Warriors won the first quarter 31–19 to lead 31–19. Curry and Lendeborg combined for 64 of 126.

4 of 5 · Where it was won

Won it shooting and off the bench

Assists 32–29; bench points 42–31. Orlando grabbed 24 offensive rebounds.

5 of 5 · Final, OT

Warriors 126, Magic 119.

From the Magic’ side: Forced overtime, then lost overtime 9–16.

What it meant: Warriors 8–4, 6th in the West, 26% top-6 odds. Magic 4–7, 9th in the East, 20%.

2 · The play of the game

The and-one.

Curry's floater through contact with 1:38 left in overtime, a three-point play that turned a 118–117 deficit into a 120–118 lead for good.
